_comment: AI Team Configuration Example - Copy to ai_team_settings.local.json and configure your LLM
_comment_custom: For custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints (e.g., local LLM, vLLM, LM Studio, etc.)
_comment_custom_openai: Example: To use a local LLM server with OpenAI-compatible API:
_comment_custom_openai_example: Set AI_PROVIDER to 'openai', OPENAI_API_KEY to 'dummy', and OPENAI_BASE_URL to 'http://localhost:8000/v1'
_comment_custom_anthropic: Example: To use a local Claude-compatible server:
_comment_custom_anthropic_example: Set AI_PROVIDER to 'anthropic', ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to 'dummy', and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to 'http://localhost:8080/v1'
